note: Latin Manipuri answer templates, one per message of satquery/agri/answer_language.py (MESSAGES). 'english' is the message; write its Latin Manipuri in 'text', keeping every {slot} exactly (code fills them with the engine's own values: levels, scores, confidence, names, counts). A template whose slots differ, that drops PLACEHOLDER or SAMPLE from a warning, or that claims a confirmed diagnosis or outbreak is refused and the English message is shown instead. 'text': null = not written yet (English is shown). Nothing here is verified: the only sentences are the ones Member A gave in the task request; every other template is left for a fluent speaker to write. Do not machine-translate.

area_risk.english: Indicators suggest {level} risk for this area.
area_risk.source: Adapted from Member A's 'Area asi da pest risk HIGH oirammi.' (2026-10-08): the word 'pest' left out for a general risk answer; a fluent speaker must confirm.

area_pest_risk.english: Indicators suggest {level} pest risk for this area.
area_pest_risk.text: Area asi da pest risk {level} oirammi.
area_pest_risk.source: Provided by Member A in the task request of 2026-10-08 (example answer sentence); slot added for the engine's value ('HIGH' -> {level}).

score.source: Provided by Member A in the task request of 2026-10-08 (example answer sentence); slot added for the engine's value ('71/100' -> {score}; the engine writes e.g. 71/100).

confidence.source: Provided by Member A in the task request of 2026-10-08 (example answer sentence); slot added for the engine's value ('LOW' -> {confidence}; the engine writes low, medium or high).

ranking_head.english: Indicators suggest HIGH or CRITICAL risk in {count} of {total} monitored areas:

ranking_none.english: No monitored area is at HIGH or CRITICAL risk by the current indicators. Highest:

no_estimate.english: No monitored area has enough data for a risk estimate.

tally.english: Moderate: {moderate}, low: {low}, not enough data: {no_data} of {total} monitored areas.

inspect_head.english: Suggested order for field inspection, by risk rank (decision support; the final choice rests with the Department):

inspect_none.english: No monitored area has enough data for a risk estimate, so no inspection order can be suggested.

not_ranked_list.english: Not ranked for lack of data: {names}.

caveat_placeholder.english: PLACEHOLDER thresholds: prototype scores, not validated agricultural findings.

caveat_sample.english: Pest-report figures are SAMPLE DATA — Prototype Simulation.

caveat_decision.english: Decision support only; the final assessment rests with the Department of Agriculture.

verify_advice.english: Field inspection and verification by an agricultural expert are recommended.
verify_advice.text: Field inspection amasung agricultural expert gi verification recommended.
verify_advice.source: Provided by Member A in the task request of 2026-10-08, verbatim.

select_area.english: Select one of the monitored areas on the map (or name it) to see why it is flagged. Assessing a newly drawn area is planned for a later phase.

ambiguous_area.english: '{phrase}' matches several monitored areas: {names}. Please name one.

no_area_match.english: No monitored area matches this question. Monitored areas: {names}.

rephrase.english: This question could not be matched with confidence to a crop & pest risk question, so it was not sent to satellite image analysis either. The risk engine answers which areas are at high risk, why a named or selected area is flagged, and which areas to inspect first. For example: {examples}

crop_health_head.english: Crop health of this area from satellite NDVI (an indicator of vegetation vigour, not a diagnosis):
